<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Burger preparation status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveredOrder" name="Delivered order"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller" processRef="Process_Robot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Customer places order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuQuestion" name="Ask menu or burger" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuChoice" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuAnswer" name="Menu or burger choice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideQuestion" name="Ask fries or wedges" sourceRef="Task_AskSideChoice" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideAnswer" name="Fries or wedges choice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Send status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveredOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_DeliveredOrder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Robot" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderProcess" name="Order received"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenuChoice" name="Ask whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" name="Receive menu or burger choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit" name="Prepare menu items in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink; duration varies by size"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskSideChoice" name="Ask whether the customer wants fries or wedges" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" name="Receive fries or wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries; duration varies by size"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges; duration varies by size"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Merge side preparation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin" name="Menu items ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BurgerMerge" name="Continue to burger preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger; duration varies by number of ingredients"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle>R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Send enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdate" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt" messageRef="Message_DeliveredOrder"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReceiveOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderProcess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOrder_AskMenu" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_AskMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskMenu_ReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveChoice_MenuGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoice_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">menuSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoice_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">burgerOnly</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplit_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplit_AskSide" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSide_ReceiveSide" sourceRef="Task_AskSideChoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSide_SideGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoice_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">friesSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoice_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wedgesSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries_SideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges_SideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMerge_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_MenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoin_BurgerMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuWorkJoin" targetRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerMerge_PrepareBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_BurgerMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareBurger_Deliver" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_End" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimer_SendUpdate" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdate_End" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
